entry.title: Open Platform Docs Site Launch
entry.summary: The open platform documentation site is now live:
entry.content:
The open platform documentation site is now live:

  • Guides — onboarding flow and available open capabilities.
  • API Reference — generated from openapi/open-api.json, the source of truth synced from the backend at build time, covering the first batch of endpoints such as Foobar.
  • Changelog — this page. Breaking and non-breaking changes to the public contract are recorded here; the breaking-change list comes from the contract diff in scripts/check-breaking.mjs.
